summary:
ORBITAL is an interactive, browser-based space mission design game that introduces players to the challenges of planning a space mission. Players select a destination, design a spacecraft, choose scientific instruments, and manage limited resources such as mass, power, budget, fuel, data, and mission lifetime.

The game features Earth, Mars, and asteroid missions. Players validate their spacecraft designs before experiencing different mission phases, from launch and transit to arrival, science operations, and data return.

ORBITAL aims to make the complex decisions behind space exploration more accessible and engaging through interactive gameplay. By experimenting with spacecraft configurations and resource trade-offs, players can develop a better understanding of the planning involved in space missions.
details:
ORBITAL is a browser-based educational game that simulates the process of designing and planning a space mission.

Players begin by selecting one of three mission destinations: Earth, Mars, or an asteroid. They then configure their spacecraft by selecting components and scientific instruments. Each design affects several mission resources, including spacecraft mass, power consumption, budget, fuel, data capacity, and mission lifetime.

Before launching, players can validate their spacecraft configuration to identify potential resource constraints. Once the mission begins, the simulation guides players through five phases: Launch, Transit, Arrival, Science Operations, and Data Return.

The project is designed to make space mission planning easier to understand through experimentation and interactive decision-making. Its main educational benefit is showing how changing one spacecraft component can affect other mission requirements.

ORBITAL was developed as a web application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Visual Studio Code and AI-assisted development tools were used during development. The project combines resource management, spacecraft configuration, mission simulation, and educational gameplay into one experience.

The creative aspect of ORBITAL is its approach of turning the complex process of spacecraft mission planning into an interactive game that can be explored through a web browser.
